verdict.rationale: Channel3 documents its own outbound webhooks: subscribing to price tracking for a product delivers webhook notifications on price changes, and its OpenAPI spec declares 5 webhooks. However, the documented event scope is narrow (price changes only), and nothing in the evidence describes how a consumer registers endpoints or how delivery works. missing for 10: documented endpoint registration and subscription management, event catalog beyond price changes, delivery semantics (signing, retries), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: When you subscribe to price tracking for a product, you can receive webhook notifications whenever the price changes.
